analyst.description: Read-only investigator and analyst for Halal Finder. Inspects codebase, PRD documents, schemas, Open Food Facts responses, and public data sources without modifying code.

committer.description: Git commit specialist. Stages and commits a specific task's changes with a project-conventional message citing PRD/ticket IDs — NEVER pushes, merges, rebases, amends, or force-pushes.

backend-coder.description: Backend implementation specialist for Halal Finder (API endpoints, database schema for places/evidence/corrections, Open Food Facts integration, moderation queue, validation, tests).

frontend-coder.description: Frontend implementation specialist for Halal Finder (PWA, mobile-first touch UI, search/filtering, map integration, ingredient screening, barcode lookup, saved places).

product-manager.description: Product-manager worker for the /product-management skill. Turns a rough list of Halal Finder issues into complete, end-to-end deliverables adhering to the PRD and sacred trust invariants.
